TITLE: The Body's Old Map
SUB: which parts of your body your planets sit on
INTRO: Astrologers have been mapping the sky onto the body for about two thousand years. In India the zodiac is laid over the body of Kalapurusha, the person of time, with Aries at the head and Pisces at the feet. Western astrologers drew the same figure and called it the zodiac man. Each planet has its own organs and systems too, and each of the twenty-seven mansions has a part of the body in an old list from the Brihat Samhita. Put together, they show which parts of you your chart keeps coming back to.
NOTE: This is the old map, for reflection. It isn't a diagnosis and it can't tell you anything a doctor can't. If something in your body is bothering you, go and get it looked at.
TABLE_NOTE: The sign is the sidereal one, which is what Jyotish reads. The house counts from your rising sign, so your 1st house is your head and your 12th is your feet. The tropical column is the sign Western medical astrology would use.

Aries.parts: the head, face, brain and eyes
Aries.line: The head takes a lot of your energy. Headaches, heat in the face, and knocks and scrapes above the neck are the classic things to watch, and so is running everything through your head instead of your body.

Taurus.parts: the throat, neck, thyroid, jaw and voice
Taurus.line: The throat and neck hold a lot. Tension tends to settle in the jaw and the back of the neck, and the voice and thyroid are the old places to keep an eye on.

Gemini.parts: the shoulders, arms, hands, lungs and breath
Gemini.line: Your breath and your hands carry the weight. Shallow breathing when you're busy, tight shoulders and tired wrists are the usual signs it's been too much.

Cancer.parts: the chest, breasts, stomach and the body's fluids
Cancer.line: Feelings go straight to your stomach. What you eat and how you feel when you eat it matter more for you than for most people.

Leo.parts: the heart, upper back, spine and circulation
Leo.line: The heart and the upper back are where you carry things. Good posture, real rest and things that make you laugh do more for you than they sound like they would.

Virgo.line: Worry goes to your gut. Digestion is the first thing to tell you when life is out of order, and routine is genuinely good medicine for you.

Libra.parts: the kidneys, lower back and the skin's balance
Libra.line: The lower back and kidneys are your soft spot. Water, balance and not sitting for too long in one position are the old advice here.

Scorpio.parts: the reproductive organs, bladder and the body's way of clearing things out
Scorpio.line: What's held in the pelvis is held for a long time. Your body clears things slowly, feelings included, so give it ways to let go.

Sagittarius.line: Your hips and thighs want to move, and the liver handles your excesses. Walking a long way is good for you. Too much of a good thing is the classic trouble.

Capricorn.parts: the knees, bones, joints, teeth and skin
Capricorn.line: Bones, joints and teeth carry the weight here. Stiffness builds slowly, so steady use and warmth do more than a big effort now and then.

Aquarius.line: Circulation and the lower legs are where things show up. Cold feet, tired calves and twisted ankles are the old signs, and moving every day keeps it flowing.

Pisces.parts: the feet, the lymph and sleep
Pisces.line: Your feet and your sleep hold a lot. You take in more from other people than you realise, and the body needs real rest to let it out again.

Sun.rules: the heart, the spine, the right eye and your overall energy
Sun.light: Your energy has a steady source. You tend to bounce back well when you've had proper rest and some sun.
Sun.strain: Your energy can run low or burn too hot. Pay attention to the heart, the eyes and the back, and to what happens when you push through tiredness.
Sun.plain: It sets how much energy you have to spend and how fast you recover.

Moon.rules: the body's fluids, the stomach, the breasts, sleep, the left eye and your moods
Moon.light: Your body settles well. Sleep, appetite and mood come back into rhythm fairly easily once life calms down.
Moon.strain: Your mood goes straight into your body. Sleep, digestion and fluid balance are the first things to shift when you're upset.
Moon.plain: It sets your rhythms: sleep, appetite and how your feelings land in your body.

Mars.rules: the blood, the muscles, heat, inflammation, cuts and burns
Mars.light: You have strong muscles and good fight in you. You heal fast from knocks and recover well from hard effort.
Mars.strain: Heat builds up. Inflammation, fevers, rashes, cuts and accidents from rushing are the classic signs, and anger tends to go straight into the body.
Mars.plain: It's your physical drive: muscle, heat and the urge to act.

Mercury.rules: the nerves, the lungs, the skin, the hands and speech
Mercury.light: Your nerves are quick and adaptable. You pick up what your body is telling you, as long as you listen.
Mercury.strain: Your nerves run hot. Overthinking turns up as jitteriness, skin trouble, shallow breathing or stomach upsets.
Mercury.plain: It's your nervous system and the way your mind talks to your body.

Jupiter.rules: the liver, fat, growth and the hips
Jupiter.light: This is the old protector. It's good for recovery and for the body's general resilience.
Jupiter.strain: Too much of a good thing. Weight, the liver and blood sugar are the old places to watch, more from excess than from lack.
Jupiter.plain: It's growth and protection: how the body builds up and how well it holds its reserves.

Venus.rules: the kidneys, the reproductive system, the throat, the face and the skin's glow
Venus.light: There's ease and grace in your body. Pleasure and beauty genuinely help you heal.
Venus.strain: The kidneys, hormones and reproductive system are the soft spots, and so is too much sugar or comfort.
Venus.plain: It's pleasure, balance and the body's hormones.

Saturn.rules: the bones, teeth, joints, the skin and anything long-term
Saturn.light: You have good stamina. The body stays strong over a long time, and it does well on routine and age.
Saturn.strain: Things build slowly and stay. Stiffness, cold, aching joints, teeth and long-running complaints are the classic Saturn trouble.
Saturn.plain: It's structure and time: the bones, and how the body ages.

Rahu.rules: the hard-to-pin-down: odd symptoms, toxins, allergies and anxiety
Rahu.light: You can be drawn to new or unusual ways of looking after yourself, and they often help.
Rahu.strain: Symptoms can be strange or hard to name. Allergies, anxiety and things that don't fit the textbook belong to Rahu.
Rahu.plain: It's the restless and unusual, and the things that are hard to pin down.

Ketu.rules: sudden things, surgery, the immune system and old, hidden complaints
Ketu.short: the immune system and sudden things
Ketu.light: The body can let go of things suddenly and cleanly. Fasting, quiet and cutting things out tend to help you.
Ketu.strain: Things can come on suddenly or hide for a long time. Ketu is linked to surgery, infections and complaints with no clear cause.
Ketu.plain: It's release: what the body lets go of, sometimes suddenly.

STRAIN: A planet is under strain when it's in its weakest sign, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th house, the houses of illness, long trouble and rest. It's where your body asks for more care, not where something is wrong.
STRAIN_NONE: None of your planets is badly placed for the body. That doesn't mean nothing will ever go wrong, just that there's no one place the chart keeps pointing at.
DOSHA_INTRO: Ayurveda describes the body with three doshas. Each planet leans toward one or two of them. Counting your rising sign's ruler and your Moon twice, and adding your Moon's mansion, this is how yours come out.

Vata.is: air and space: movement, nerves, dryness and cold
Vata.line: With Vata leading you're quick and changeable, and you run out of steam fast. Warmth, regular meals, oil on the skin and early nights are the old ways to settle it.

Pitta.is: fire and water: heat, digestion, drive and sharpness
Pitta.line: With Pitta leading you run hot, in temper and in body. Cooling food, not skipping meals, and not competing with yourself are the old ways to calm it.

Kapha.is: earth and water: structure, steadiness, softness and calm
Kapha.line: With Kapha leading you're steady and strong, and slow to start. Movement, lighter food, and getting up early are the old ways to keep it from getting heavy.

HOUSES.1: the 1st house is the body itself and its strength
HOUSES.6: the 6th house is illness and how you heal, and your daily habits
HOUSES.8: the 8th house is long-running trouble, surgery and how long things last
HOUSES.12: the 12th house is rest, sleep, hospitals and the feet
